subject.title: [Feature]: Add screenshot capture button to Control UI chat input (like Doubao)

question: Should OpenClaw add a core Control UI static screenshot capture button now, and what privacy/permission behavior must it enforce?
rationale: Automation cannot safely choose the browser/native capture UX, consent boundary, sensitive-content handling, or whether this should be split from the broader screen-sharing product direction.

options.title: Approve a narrow static-capture spec
options.body: Define a screenshot-only composer control that captures one image, shows a removable preview, and sends through existing attachments with explicit permission and cancellation behavior.

options.title: Fold into screen sharing design
options.body: Keep this open as a subset of the broader realtime screen-sharing direction and avoid a one-off capture UI until that security model is settled.

options.title: Decline core capture for now
options.body: Rely on upload, paste, and drop attachments until maintainers decide capture should be handled outside core or by a future plugin/API surface.

recommendation.title: Approve a narrow static-capture spec
recommendation.body: Define a screenshot-only composer control that captures one image, shows a removable preview, and sends through existing attachments with explicit permission and cancellation behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The current Control UI chat composer/send files route most clearly through his recent merged work, and the decision spans Control UI UX plus security posture.
